about: Hand-written inputs; answers by madar-card (MADAR_REGENERATE_CARD_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p madar-card vectors), reviewed by hand. validate: [code, path] pairs per design and shop. layout: where elements land (canvas pixels).

layout.name: classic_apple_3x_arabic
layout.why: x3, mirrored: the footer is the Arabic file (108x19 -> 324x57) at the right edge of its cell

layout.name: primary_zone_apple_2x
layout.why: the zone Apple writes the primary field in: 8x4 cells

validate.name: classic_is_clean
validate.why: today's look: a bar on row 4 above the footer, balance in the header

validate.name: wrong_version
validate.why: a version this crate does not know is refused before anything else

validate.name: bad_colour
validate.why: #12345 is not #RRGGBB

validate.name: low_contrast
validate.why: #EFF3F4 on #FFFFFF is about 1.1:1, under the 3:1 the balance needs; the label too (a warning)

validate.name: over_the_footer
validate.why: row 5, columns 0-5 hold the footer; a bar there covers it

validate.name: overlap
validate.why: two elements share cells (0..12,4) and (6..12,4)

validate.name: under_the_primary_field
validate.why: with a primary field, cells 0-7 x 0-3 are Apple's; stamps at (0,0) collide

validate.name: primary_field_with_stamps_on_the_right
validate.why: the same stamps moved to columns 8-11 leave the zone free: 4 cols x 3 rows = 114.3 x 64 pt, 5 stamps -> 2 rows of 3 -> min(38.1,32)*0.82 = 26.2 pt

validate.name: stamps_too_small
validate.why: 5 stamps in one cell (28.6 x 21.3 pt at 1x): one row -> min(5.7, 21.3) x 0.82 = 4.7 pt, two rows -> min(9.5, 10.7) x 0.82 = 7.8 pt; under the 12 pt floor either way

validate.name: stamps_on_points
validate.why: a points programme has no stamps to draw on track 1

validate.name: track_unknown
validate.why: track 3 does not exist in a one-track shop, on the strip and in a field

validate.name: photo_without_photo
validate.why: the shop has no card photograph

validate.name: pattern_without_pattern
validate.why: a pattern ground must name its pattern

validate.name: text_does_not_fit
validate.why: 'Free coffee every week!' 23 x 0.6 x 22 = 303.6 pt > 4 cols (114.3)

validate.name: text_empty
validate.why: a text element with no words

validate.name: too_many_fields
validate.why: Apple: 2 secondary + 2 auxiliary = 4 > 3 (one auxiliary slot is the notice's); 3 header > 2

validate.name: two_tracks
validate.why: one stamp row per track with labels; both tracks visible

validate.name: a_track_left_off
validate.why: track 2 (tracks[1]) runs but neither the strip nor a field shows it: a warning, not an error

validate.name: bar_too_short
validate.why: a bar needs at least 3 columns

validate.name: logo_too_small
validate.why: the logo needs at least 2 x 2 cells

validate.name: count_too_small
validate.why: a 50-stamp card in one cell: '50/50' is 5 characters, 28.6 / (5 x 0.6) = 9.5 pt < 10 (the height allows 21.3 x 0.72 = 15.4)
